The '''HR-1200''' was an unusual device manufactured by [[Farendress Defel Exports]]. It consisted of [[power plate]]s containing [[Defel micro-organism]]s that fed on [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. The creatures absorbed heat sources and created electricity which was then stored in [[Battery/Legends|battery]] cells. In an environment with high levels of radiation, the HR-1200 could produce enough energy to power several small appliances such as [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]].
